meta.name: user-story-mapping
meta.description: Create a user story map that lays out activities, steps, tasks, and release slices. Use when planning a workflow, backlog, or MVP around the user journey.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将用户旅程拆解为可交付的功能切片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用用户故事地图规划产品路线图或迭代。
copy.tagline_en: Break down user journeys into deliverable slices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a product roadmap or iteration using user story mapping.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你创建用户故事地图：先定义用户和叙事，再按时间顺序列出活动、步骤和任务，最后按优先级划分发布切片。
howto.when: 当你需要规划用户旅程、梳理待办事项或确定最小可行产品（MVP）范围时，可以要求 Claude 创建故事地图。

say.text: 帮我为报销流程创建一个故事地图，从提交到打款。
say.note: Claude 会引导你逐步完成地图。

say.text: 为我们的新功能做用户故事地图，MVP 只包含核心步骤。
say.note: Claude 会帮你识别 MVP 范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to create a user story map: first define the user and narrative, then list activities, steps, and tasks in chronological order, and finally prioritize and slice releases.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to plan a user journey, organize a backlog, or define an MVP scope. You can ask Claude to create a story map.

say_en.text: Create a story map for our expense reporting flow, from submission to reimbursement.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you step by step.

say_en.text: Do a user story map for our new feature, with MVP only covering core steps.
say_en.note: Claude will help identify MVP scope.
